ns2:section.sectionText: This course provides a broad overview of Immersive Media preparing students to explore the latest immersive technologies including 360˚ video production and distribution via the web, mobile devices and VR headsets. We begin with a look back at Immersive Media milestones over the past 100 years as we collectively build an online, interactive timeline. Student teams will then research media production specializations for Augmented and Virtual reality including 360-degree photography, photogrammetry, spatial sound design and game development engines like Unity and UnReal. Throughout the 8-week term, student teams will work to design, shoot and edit a professional-level, 3-8 minute, 360˚ video for viewing online and within the HTC Vive headset.
